# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

The supplied corpus is a large batch of raw call snippets, and the great majority are **not real outbound/inbound sales conversations** — they are internal logistics chatter (loading/unloading instructions, lorry/porter coordination, driver route directions, gate/watchman calls, bill-copy and payment-follow-up calls, staff personal/medical conversations, a telemarketing cold-call *to* Crayon, and an expo-vendor cold-call). These have been excluded per instructions.

After filtering, there is a **genuine but modest set of real sales calls** — roughly 35-45 usable enquiry/negotiation calls — covering: (1) customer enquiries for roofing-sheet rates (JSW Color On Plus, Pragathi Plus, Indira Dhanush), (2) dealer/fabricator rate-matching and discount negotiations, (3) screws/welding-rod/electrode order calls, (4) a few decking-sheet, polycarbonate-sheet, puff-panel and flashing-accessory enquiries, and (5) one informative outbound cold-call where a Crayon rep explains the company to a car-shed customer. Because the company is primarily a **distributor/dealer of JSW-brand roofing sheets and allied hardware (not a fabricator)**, this KB is scoped strictly to what is actually said. Given the small number of true sales calls, conclusions below should be read as directional, not exhaustive.

## Products & brand ladder

Based only on what customers/staff discuss on calls, Crayon Roofing & Structures supplies:

- **Metal roofing sheets (JSW brand, profiled/corrugated), sold as material supply only — no fabrication/fixing.** Confirmed in the car-shed enquiry call: *"Sir JSW metal roofing sheet நம்ம பண்ணிட்டு இருக்கோம். Supply பண்ணிட்டு இருக்கோம் sir. Fixing எதுவும் பண்றது கிடையாது."* [We do JSW metal roofing sheets, only supply, no fixing.]
- **Brand ladder (high→low tier, as repeatedly stated to customers):**
  - **JSW Color On Plus** — premium line, AZ150 coating, available in all colors (sky blue, off white, grey, blue, red, brick red). *"color on plus-னா நம்ம எல்லா color-உம் இருக்கும்"* [In Color On Plus all colors are available].
  - **Pragathi / Pragathi Plus** — mid tier, cheaper, but color-limited (usually only sky blue & off white; grey/brick red not normally stocked). *"Pragathi-ல sky blue off white மட்டும் தான் இருக்கும்."*
  - **Indira Dhanush (JSW)** — entry tier, thinner AZ70, cheapest, 2 colors only.
  - **Silver On Plus / bare galvanized (plain, non-color) sheets** — sold by kg, used for plain/L-sheet work.
- **Thickness range discussed:** 0.35/0.40/0.45/0.47/0.50/0.60 mm.
- **Decking sheets** (0.8 / 1.0 / 1.2 mm) — for floor/platform work, e.g., transformer-platform use case.
- **Polycarbonate sheets** (2mm) — small enquiries.
- **PUF (Puff) roof panels**, 50mm thickness — quoted per square meter.
- **Accessories:** L-flashing (RMS/length based), ridge/crimp/profile sheet end-work, self-cleaning screws, stitch screws.
- **Hardware line:** Tata-brand screws (self-tapping, various mm/inch sizes, single/double thread, full-thread/off-thread), Tata welding electrodes/rods (2.5mm etc.), CO2 welding wire coils, cutting/grinding wheels.
- Company explicitly told a caller it does **not** do UPVC sheet, arch/curved roofing on its machine, or fabrication: *"இந்த arch நம்ம machine-ல போட முடியாது."*

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)

All rates are **+GST/tax** unless noted, and are **square-meter basis unless stated as kg**:

| Product | Rate quoted |
|---|---|
| JSW Color On Plus 0.50mm AZ150 | ₹475 + GST/sq.m (one call); ₹465/₹445 negotiated in another; earlier ₹116+tax quoted on a different occasion |
| JSW Color On Plus 0.47mm AZ150 | ₹435 + GST; also ₹430 + GST and ₹445 + GST in separate calls |
| JSW Color On Plus 0.60mm AZ150 | ₹560 + GST/sq.m |
| Pragathi Plus 0.47mm AZ70 | ₹405 + GST/sq.m |
| Indira Dhanush 0.45mm AZ70 | ₹375 + GST/sq.m |
| Pragathi 0.40mm | ₹105 + GST |
| Silver On Plus AZ150 0.47mm (kg basis) | ₹101 + GST/kg |
| Plain/bare galv sheet 0.40mm, 3.45m length | ₹100–101 + GST/kg |
| PUF roof panel, 50mm | ₹1,600 + GST/sq.m (top & bottom thickness mentioned separately; loading extra) |
| Welding electrode (2.5mm) | ₹332–336 incl. GST normally; ₹270 + GST as a special "offer price" |
| Tata self-tapping screw (130mm, with washer-type gasket) | ₹14 + GST each |

**Cash-and-carry vs credit pricing** is a recurring, explicit policy: *"Cash and Carry-க்கு ₹100-ன்னா credit-க்கு ₹1 extra."* [Cash and carry ₹100, credit is ₹1 more per kg]. This ₹1/kg gap is repeatedly the center of dealer disputes (see Objection Playbook).

**Price-hike notice (1st of month):** Multiple calls reference a **10% increase from the 1st** on welding rod, screws, cutting wheel, and "color coated" items, driving urgency ("இப்ப எடுத்துக்கலாம்... 1st தேதி ஏறுது" [buy now, price rises from the 1st]).

**Delivery/commercial terms mentioned:**
- Monday/Tuesday dispatch common for screw stock-outs; 1-day lead time for coil "run" production.
- 50% advance required for bulk B2B orders before dispatch is confirmed.
- E-way bill / government portal downtime cited as a real dispatch blocker on at least two days (used both as fact and, candidly, sometimes as an excuse by staff).
- Loading cut-off ~6:00 PM; after that, no e-way bill/billing possible.
- Bulk/dealer rate is explicitly said to equal shop/dealer rate — "கடைக்காரங்களுக்கு என்ன price கொடுப்போமோ அதுதான் உங்களுக்கும்."

## Objection Playbook

**1. "Competitor/another dealer is giving it cheaper" (APJ/₹98.50 vs ₹100)**
- Customer/dealer leverage: *"ஆளுக்கு 1 price குடுத்திருந்தா நம்ம ரொம்ப கஷ்டம்"* [If we give different prices to different people, it's very hard for us].
- Response used: verify who actually quoted it, check if it was a rotation/loss-leader sale ("rotation-க்காக குடுத்தாங்களான்னு தெரியல"), and escalate to management before matching — never match blind.

**2. "Reduce the price / management discount"**
- Standard deflection: *"Final rate தான் Sir... கடைக்காரங்களுக்கு என்ன price கொடுப்போமோ அதேதான் உங்களுக்கும் கொடுத்திருக்கோம்."* [This is final rate — same as what we give shopkeepers].
- When pressed, rep explicitly frames it as having already gone to MD for approval, then may concede a token ₹2 or ₹5/sq.m reduction, never on full order without approval.

**3. Overdue bills / payment collection**
- Direct ultimatum style: *"70 நாளுக்கு மேல 3 bill இருக்குது"* [3 bills over 70 days pending] → request partial payment now and close with "2 bill போட்டு விடுங்க" [settle 2 bills].
- Collection calls are polite but persistent, always re-confirming "Monday காலைல clear ஆயிடும்" [will clear Monday morning] type promises and follow-up.
